name.value: Vanguard All-World ex-US Shares Index ETF
name.note: Name on Vanguard's fact sheet dated 31 Aug 2026 (the latest published for VEU on 19 Oct 2026). The ASX listing is a CHESS Depositary Interest (CDI) over the US-domiciled Vanguard FTSE All-World ex-US ETF (NYSE: VEU).

mer.note: Management cost on the fact sheet dated 31 Aug 2026 (the US fund's expense ratio)

yield.note: Trailing 12 months of cash distributions / NAV on 16 Oct 2026, both in US dollars: US$1.9608 (0.1968 + 0.3928 + 0.1132 + 1.2580, ex-dates 19 Dec 2025 to 18 Sep 2026) / US$81.39 NAV. Distributions are declared in US$ per CDI and paid to Australian holders in A$ (e.g. Sep 2026: US$0.1968 = A$0.2790 at 1.417619), gross of US withholding tax. Vanguard's 1-year income (distribution) return was 2.88% to 30 Sep 2026 (3.23% to 31 Aug 2026 on the fact sheet).

franking.note: No franking credits: US-domiciled fund holding non-Australian shares; distributions are subject to US withholding tax instead

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here. Vanguard's fact sheet says 'ETF listed on ASX 12 May 2009'.

currency.note: The ASX CDIs trade in AUD; the underlying US fund's NAV and distributions are in USD (distributions are paid to Australian holders in AUD).

inception.note: Inception of the US fund Vanguard FTSE All-World ex-US ETF (NYSE: VEU), 2 Mar 2007; the ASX listing is a CDI cross-listing of that fund, listed on the ASX 12 May 2009 per Vanguard (8 May 2009 per ASX company data).
